title: Policies for Information Security
objective: Define and manage information security policies aligned with business requirements.
description: A set of policies for information security shall be defined, approved by management, published and communicated to employees and relevant external parties.
implementation_guidance: Develop an information security policy document approved by top management
Review the policy at planned intervals or when significant changes occur
Ensure the policy is communicated to all employees and relevant external parties
Define specific topic-specific policies (e.g., access control, cryptography)
expected_outcomes: Information security policy is documented and approved by management
Policy is communicated and understood across the organization
Policy is reviewed regularly and updated as needed
Topic-specific policies support the overarching information security policy
audit_intent: Verify the organization has established, approved, communicated, and maintained information security policies.

title: Information Security Roles and Responsibilities
objective: Assign information security responsibilities clearly.
description: Information security responsibilities shall be assigned and communicated.
implementation_guidance: Define information security roles and responsibilities for all employees
Assign a person or team with overall responsibility for information security
Document and communicate role definitions
Include security responsibilities in job descriptions
expected_outcomes: Clear assignment of information security responsibilities
Accountability for security decisions is established
Employees understand their security obligations
audit_intent: Verify that information security roles, responsibilities, and accountabilities are defined and allocated.

title: Segregation of Duties
objective: Reduce risk of fraud, error, and circumvention of controls.
description: Conflicting duties and areas of responsibility shall be segregated to reduce opportunities for unauthorized or unintentional modification or misuse of the organization's assets.
implementation_guidance: Identify conflicting duties that could enable fraud or error
Implement separation of incompatible duties across systems and processes
Establish oversight mechanisms to detect circumvention
Document segregation of duties matrix for critical functions
expected_outcomes: No single person can compromise critical processes alone
Conflicting duties are separated across different individuals or teams
Monitoring detects attempts to bypass segregation
audit_intent: Verify that conflicting duties are segregated to reduce risk of unauthorized activity.

title: Management Responsibilities
objective: Ensure management demonstrates leadership and commitment to information security.
description: Management shall require all employees and contractors to apply information security in accordance with the established policies and procedures.
implementation_guidance: Management to actively demonstrate commitment to information security
Communicate the importance of effective information security management
Ensure adequate resources for information security
Conduct regular management reviews of the ISMS
expected_outcomes: Management demonstrates visible leadership in information security
Resources are allocated for information security activities
Management reviews the ISMS at planned intervals
audit_intent: Verify that management demonstrates leadership, commitment, and accountability for the ISMS.

title: Contact with Authorities
objective: Establish effective communication with regulatory and law enforcement authorities.
description: The organization shall establish and maintain contact with relevant authorities.
implementation_guidance: Identify relevant authorities applicable to the organization's sector and region
Establish procedures for contacting authorities in the event of security incidents
Document escalation paths for breach notification requirements
Maintain awareness of regulatory reporting obligations
expected_outcomes: Contact points with relevant authorities are established and maintained
Procedures exist for incident notification to authorities
Breach notification obligations are understood and documented
audit_intent: Verify that the organization has established and maintained contact with relevant authorities.

title: Contact with Special Interest Groups
objective: Stay informed about information security best practices and threats.
description: The organization shall establish and maintain contact with special interest groups or other specialist security forums and professional associations.
implementation_guidance: Identify relevant security groups, forums, and professional associations
Encourage participation in information sharing communities (e.g., ISACs)
Establish a process for receiving threat intelligence and security advisories
Document how information from groups is evaluated and acted upon
expected_outcomes: Membership or contact with information security groups is established
Security intelligence and advisories are received and evaluated
Participation in threat intelligence sharing where appropriate
audit_intent: Verify that the organization engages with information security groups and threat intelligence sources.

title: Threat Intelligence
objective: Maintain awareness of the threat landscape to proactively defend the organization.
description: Information relating to information security threats shall be collected and analyzed to produce threat intelligence.
implementation_guidance: Identify sources of threat intelligence relevant to the organization's industry
Establish a process for collecting, analyzing, and disseminating threat intelligence
Integrate threat intelligence into risk assessment and security operations
Review threat intelligence sources regularly for relevance and quality
expected_outcomes: Threat intelligence is systematically collected and analyzed
Threat intelligence informs security decisions and risk assessments
Security controls are adjusted based on evolving threat landscape
audit_intent: Verify the organization systematically collects and acts upon threat intelligence.

title: Information Security in Project Management
objective: Integrate information security into project management practices.
description: Information security shall be integrated into project management throughout the project lifecycle.
implementation_guidance: Include information security requirements in project initiation documents
Conduct security assessments for projects handling sensitive information
Integrate security tasks into project plans and milestones
Ensure project managers have security awareness and guidance
expected_outcomes: Security is embedded in project management methodology
Projects identify and address security requirements from initiation
Project deliverables meet security requirements
audit_intent: Verify that information security is integrated into project management practices.

title: Inventory of Information and Other Associated Assets
objective: Maintain a complete and accurate inventory of all information assets.
description: An inventory of information and other associated assets, including owners, shall be developed and maintained.
implementation_guidance: Identify all information assets and their associated physical and software assets
Assign ownership for each asset
Maintain the inventory in a current state with regular reviews
Classify assets based on their criticality and sensitivity
expected_outcomes: Complete asset inventory is maintained and current
Each asset has a designated owner
Assets are classified according to their value and sensitivity
Asset inventory is reviewed at planned intervals
audit_intent: Verify that an asset inventory exists, is current, and has assigned owners.

title: Acceptable Use of Information and Other Associated Assets
objective: Define and enforce acceptable use rules for information assets.
description: Rules for the acceptable use of information and other associated assets shall be identified, documented, and implemented.
implementation_guidance: Develop rules for acceptable use of information assets
Communicate acceptable use rules to all users
Implement technical controls to enforce acceptable use policies
Monitor compliance with acceptable use rules
expected_outcomes: Acceptable use rules are documented and communicated
Users understand their obligations regarding asset use
Technical controls enforce acceptable use policies
audit_intent: Verify that acceptable use policies are defined, communicated, and enforced.

title: Return of Assets
objective: Ensure assets are properly returned when employment or contracts end.
description: Employees and external party users shall return all organizational assets in their possession upon termination of their employment, contract, or agreement.
implementation_guidance: Include asset return requirements in employment contracts and agreements
Define a formal process for asset return upon termination
Verify return of physical and digital assets
Disable access rights promptly upon termination
expected_outcomes: Assets are returned upon termination of employment or contract
Access rights are revoked promptly on termination
Process for asset recovery is documented and followed
audit_intent: Verify that the organization has procedures for recovering assets upon termination.

title: Classification of Information
objective: Ensure information is classified according to its sensitivity and criticality.
description: Information shall be classified according to the organization's information security needs based on confidentiality, integrity, availability, and relevant legal requirements.
implementation_guidance: Develop an information classification scheme (e.g., public, internal, confidential, restricted)
Define classification levels with clear handling requirements
Assign classification labels to information assets
Include classification in awareness training
expected_outcomes: Information classification scheme is defined
Assets are classified according to the scheme
Handling procedures correspond to classification levels
audit_intent: Verify that information is classified according to sensitivity and criticality.

title: Labelling of Information
objective: Ensure classified information is properly labelled for handling and protection.
description: Procedures for information labelling shall be developed and implemented in accordance with the information classification scheme.
implementation_guidance: Develop labelling procedures for each classification level
Implement automated labelling where possible
Ensure labels are visible on both physical and digital information
Handle unlabelled information at the highest classification level until classified
expected_outcomes: Labelling procedures aligned with classification scheme exist
Information assets carry appropriate labels
Automated labelling tools are used where feasible
audit_intent: Verify that information labelling procedures align with the classification scheme.

title: Information Transfer
objective: Protect information during transfer within and outside the organization.
description: Information transfer rules, procedures, and agreements shall be in place for all types of transfer facilities within the organization and between the organization and other parties.
implementation_guidance: Define rules for information transfer based on classification
Implement secure transfer mechanisms (encryption, secure protocols)
Establish agreements for information exchange with external parties
Log and monitor information transfers
expected_outcomes: Information transfers are protected according to classification
Secure transfer mechanisms are in place
Exchange agreements exist with external parties
audit_intent: Verify that information is protected during transfer through appropriate technical and procedural controls.

title: Access Control
objective: Control access to information and information processing facilities.
description: Rules for access to information and other associated assets shall be established and enforced, based on business and information security requirements.
implementation_guidance: Define an access control policy based on business and security requirements
Implement the principle of least privilege
Provide access only on a need-to-know and need-to-use basis
Regularly review access rights and remove unnecessary privileges
expected_outcomes: Access control policy is documented and enforced
Least privilege principle is applied
Access rights are reviewed at planned intervals
Access provisioning and de-provisioning processes exist
audit_intent: Verify that access control rules are defined, implemented, and enforced across the organization.

title: Identity Management
objective: Manage the complete lifecycle of digital identities.
description: The complete lifecycle of identities shall be managed.
implementation_guidance: Establish a process for identity provisioning, modification, and de-provisioning
Implement unique identification of all users
Remove or disable identities promptly when no longer needed
Conduct periodic reviews of identity records
expected_outcomes: Identity lifecycle management processes are defined and followed
Each user has a unique identifier
Inactive identities are removed or disabled promptly
audit_intent: Verify that identities are managed throughout their lifecycle from creation to removal.

title: Authentication Information
objective: Securely manage authentication information throughout its lifecycle.
description: Assignment and management of authentication information shall be controlled by a management process, including advising personnel on the appropriate handling of authentication information.
implementation_guidance: Enforce strong password policies (length, complexity, rotation)
Implement MFA for privileged and remote access
Provide secure mechanisms for password reset and recovery
Ensure authentication information is not stored in plaintext
expected_outcomes: Authentication information is managed securely
Strong password policies are enforced
MFA is implemented for privileged access and remote access
Password reset procedures are secure
audit_intent: Verify that authentication information (passwords, keys, tokens) is managed through a secure lifecycle process.

title: Access Rights
objective: Provision, review, and revoke access rights in a controlled manner.
description: Access rights to information and other associated assets shall be provisioned, reviewed, modified, and removed in accordance with the organization's access control policy.
implementation_guidance: Implement a formal access rights provisioning process
Conduct periodic reviews of access rights (at least quarterly for critical systems)
Remove or modify access rights promptly upon role changes or termination
Maintain records of access rights assignments
expected_outcomes: Access rights provisioning follows a formal process
Access rights are reviewed at planned intervals
Access rights are promptly updated on role changes or termination
Records of access rights are maintained
audit_intent: Verify that access rights are provisioned, reviewed, modified, and removed through a formal process.

title: Information Security in Supplier Relationships
objective: Protect organizational information assets accessible by suppliers.
description: Processes and procedures shall be defined and implemented to manage information security risks associated with supplier relationships.
implementation_guidance: Identify supplier relationships that involve access to organizational information
Assess information security risks for each supplier
Include information security requirements in supplier agreements
Monitor supplier compliance with security requirements
expected_outcomes: Supplier security risks are assessed and documented
Security requirements are included in supplier agreements
Supplier compliance with security requirements is monitored
audit_intent: Verify that the organization manages information security risks in supplier relationships.

title: Addressing Security Within Supplier Agreements
objective: Ensure supplier agreements include information security requirements.
description: Information security requirements for mitigating risks associated with supplier access to the organization's assets shall be agreed upon and documented with each supplier.
implementation_guidance: Define information security clauses for supplier contracts
Include requirements for data protection, confidentiality, and breach notification
Specify right to audit suppliers
Define service levels and security metrics in agreements
expected_outcomes: Supplier agreements contain information security requirements
Confidentiality and data protection obligations are documented
Right to audit suppliers is included in agreements
audit_intent: Verify that supplier agreements include documented information security requirements.

title: Managing Information Security in the ICT Supply Chain
objective: Manage information security risks across the ICT supply chain.
description: Processes shall be defined and implemented to manage the information security risks associated with the ICT products and services supply chain.
implementation_guidance: Identify and assess risks in the ICT supply chain
Define security requirements for ICT products and services
Monitor the supply chain for security incidents and vulnerabilities
Apply defense-in-depth principles to supply chain security
expected_outcomes: ICT supply chain risks are identified and assessed
Security requirements are specified for ICT products and services
Supply chain security incidents are monitored
audit_intent: Verify that the organization manages information security risks across the ICT supply chain.

title: Monitoring, Review and Change Management of Supplier Services
objective: Ensure supplier services are monitored, reviewed, and changes are managed.
description: The organization shall regularly monitor, review, and audit supplier service delivery.
implementation_guidance: Monitor supplier service delivery against agreed service levels
Conduct regular reviews of supplier security posture
Establish a process for managing changes to supplier services
Maintain incident reporting and escalation procedures with suppliers
expected_outcomes: Supplier service delivery is monitored and reviewed
Changes to supplier services are managed through a formal process
Supplier incidents are reported and escalated appropriately
audit_intent: Verify that supplier services are monitored, reviewed, and changes are managed.

title: Information Security for Use of Cloud Services
objective: Ensure appropriate information security when using cloud services.
description: Processes for acquisition, use, management, and exit from cloud services shall be established in accordance with the organization's information security requirements.
implementation_guidance: Define cloud service security requirements before procurement
Assess cloud service providers for security posture and compliance
Establish clear data ownership and data protection terms in cloud agreements
Define exit strategy for cloud service termination
expected_outcomes: Cloud services are assessed for security before adoption
Cloud agreements include data protection and security requirements
Exit strategy exists for each cloud service
Cloud security is monitored continuously
audit_intent: Verify that cloud services are acquired, used, managed, and decommissioned securely.

title: Information Security Incident Management Planning and Preparation
objective: Plan and prepare for information security incidents.
description: The organization shall plan and prepare for information security incidents by defining, establishing, and communicating incident management processes and responsibilities.
implementation_guidance: Establish an incident management policy and procedure
Define roles and responsibilities for incident response
Create incident response playbooks for common incident types
Conduct regular incident response exercises and tabletop simulations
expected_outcomes: Incident management policy and procedures are documented
Incident response roles and responsibilities are defined
Incident response playbooks exist and are tested
Personnel are trained on incident response procedures
audit_intent: Verify that the organization has planned and prepared for information security incidents.

title: Assessment and Decision on Information Security Events
objective: Assess information security events and decide if they constitute incidents.
description: Information security events shall be assessed and it shall be decided if they are to be classified as information security incidents.
implementation_guidance: Establish criteria for classifying events as incidents
Implement monitoring and detection mechanisms to identify events
Define escalation thresholds and procedures
Log and track all security events through triage
expected_outcomes: Security events are identified and logged
Events are assessed against incident classification criteria
Incident declaration follows established criteria
audit_intent: Verify that information security events are assessed and classified as incidents when appropriate.

title: Response to Information Security Incidents
objective: Respond to information security incidents effectively and promptly.
description: Information security incidents shall be responded to in accordance with the documented incident management procedures.
implementation_guidance: Activate incident response team upon incident declaration
Follow documented response procedures and playbooks
Contain, eradicate, and recover from incidents
Document all actions taken during incident response
expected_outcomes: Incidents are responded to promptly and effectively
Incident containment limits damage
Evidence is preserved for forensic analysis
Lessons learned are captured for improvement
audit_intent: Verify that the organization responds to information security incidents according to documented procedures.

title: Learning from Information Security Incidents
objective: Derive lessons from incidents to improve security posture.
description: Knowledge gained from analyzing and resolving information security incidents shall be used to strengthen controls and reduce future incident likelihood or impact.
implementation_guidance: Conduct post-incident reviews to identify root causes
Document lessons learned and action items
Update incident response plans and playbooks based on lessons
Share relevant learnings across the organization
expected_outcomes: Post-incident reviews are conducted systematically
Lessons learned are documented and actioned
Controls are improved based on incident learnings
audit_intent: Verify that lessons learned from incidents are systematically captured and used for improvement.

title: Collection of Evidence
objective: Collect and preserve evidence in a manner suitable for legal or disciplinary action.
description: The organization shall establish and implement procedures for the identification, collection, acquisition, and preservation of evidence related to information security events.
implementation_guidance: Define evidence collection procedures that meet legal and evidentiary standards
Establish chain of custody procedures
Use forensic tools and techniques for evidence preservation
Ensure personnel handling evidence are appropriately trained
expected_outcomes: Evidence collection procedures exist and are documented
Chain of custody is maintained for all evidence
Evidence is preserved in a forensically sound manner
audit_intent: Verify that the organization has procedures for collecting and preserving evidence in a forensically sound manner.

title: Information Security During Disruption
objective: Maintain information security during disruptions.
description: The organization shall plan how to maintain information security at an acceptable level during any disruption.
implementation_guidance: Integrate information security into business continuity planning
Define minimum security levels required during disruptions
Identify alternate processing arrangements that meet security requirements
Test security controls during business continuity exercises
expected_outcomes: Information security is maintained during disruptions
Business continuity plans include information security requirements
Alternate processing facilities meet security requirements
Security during disruptions is tested regularly
audit_intent: Verify that the organization has planned to maintain information security during disruptions.

title: ICT Readiness for Business Continuity
objective: Ensure ICT systems are ready to support business continuity requirements.
description: ICT readiness shall be planned, implemented, maintained, and tested based on business continuity objectives and ICT continuity requirements.
implementation_guidance: Define ICT continuity requirements based on business impact analysis
Implement redundant systems and failover capabilities
Test ICT continuity arrangements regularly
Document and maintain ICT continuity plans
expected_outcomes: ICT continuity requirements are defined and documented
Redundant and failover systems are in place for critical services
ICT continuity plans are tested at planned intervals
Recovery time and recovery point objectives are met
audit_intent: Verify that ICT readiness for business continuity is planned, implemented, maintained, and tested.

title: Legal, Statutory, Regulatory and Contractual Requirements
objective: Identify and address legal, statutory, regulatory, and contractual requirements.
description: Legal, statutory, regulatory, and contractual requirements relevant to information security shall be identified, documented, and kept up to date.
implementation_guidance: Maintain a register of applicable legal and regulatory requirements
Identify contractual information security obligations
Review requirements regularly for changes
Assess compliance with identified requirements
expected_outcomes: Legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements are identified and documented
Requirements are reviewed and updated regularly
Compliance with requirements is assessed
audit_intent: Verify that the organization identifies and maintains awareness of applicable legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements.

title: Intellectual Property Rights
objective: Protect intellectual property rights (IPR).
description: The organization shall implement procedures to protect intellectual property rights.
implementation_guidance: Establish procedures for protecting intellectual property
Ensure licensed software is used in compliance with license terms
Implement controls to prevent unauthorized copying or distribution
Conduct periodic audits of software and IP usage
expected_outcomes: IPR protection procedures are documented
Software is used in compliance with license terms
Unauthorized copying and distribution are prevented
audit_intent: Verify that the organization protects intellectual property rights.

title: Protection of Records
objective: Protect records from loss, destruction, falsification, and unauthorized access.
description: Records shall be protected from loss, destruction, falsification, unauthorized access, and unauthorized release, in accordance with legal, regulatory, contractual, and business requirements.
implementation_guidance: Define records retention schedules based on legal and business requirements
Implement controls to prevent unauthorized modification or deletion of records
Ensure records are stored securely with appropriate access controls
Implement backup and disaster recovery for critical records
expected_outcomes: Records retention and disposition schedules are defined
Records are protected from unauthorized access and modification
Records are available when needed for business or legal purposes
Disposal of records follows documented procedures
audit_intent: Verify that records are protected from loss, destruction, falsification, and unauthorized access.

title: Privacy and Protection of Personally Identifiable Information
objective: Protect personally identifiable information (PII) in accordance with applicable laws.
description: The organization shall identify and meet the requirements for privacy and protection of personally identifiable information according to applicable laws, regulations, and contractual requirements.
implementation_guidance: Identify PII within the organization and map its flow
Implement privacy controls aligned with GDPR or equivalent regulations
Establish data subject rights processes (access, erasure, portability)
Conduct data protection impact assessments for high-risk processing
expected_outcomes: PII is identified and protected according to legal requirements
Privacy notices and consent mechanisms are in place
Data subject rights can be fulfilled within required timeframes
Data protection impact assessments are conducted as needed
audit_intent: Verify that the organization protects personally identifiable information in accordance with legal requirements.

title: Independent Review of Information Security
objective: Ensure the organization's approach to information security is reviewed independently.
description: The organization's approach to managing information security and its implementation shall be reviewed independently at planned intervals.
implementation_guidance: Conduct internal audits of the ISMS at planned intervals
Engage external auditors for independent assessments
Define audit scope and criteria based on risk assessment results
Ensure auditors are independent of the areas being audited
expected_outcomes: Independent reviews are conducted at planned intervals
Audit findings are documented and actioned
Management reviews audit results and drives improvement
audit_intent: Verify that the organization's information security approach is reviewed independently at planned intervals.

title: Compliance with Policies, Rules, and Standards for Information Security
objective: Ensure compliance with organizational information security policies and standards.
description: Compliance with information security policies, rules, and standards shall be regularly reviewed.
implementation_guidance: Conduct regular compliance reviews against policies and standards
Use automated tools to monitor compliance where possible
Document and report non-compliance findings
Implement corrective actions for non-compliance
expected_outcomes: Compliance with policies and standards is monitored
Non-compliance is detected, documented, and addressed
Compliance reporting is provided to management
audit_intent: Verify that compliance with information security policies, rules, and standards is regularly reviewed.

title: Documented Operating Procedures
objective: Ensure information processing facilities are operated correctly and securely.
description: Operating procedures for information processing facilities shall be documented and made available to personnel who need them.
implementation_guidance: Document procedures for the operation of information processing facilities
Keep procedures current and accessible to authorized personnel
Include step-by-step instructions for security-relevant tasks
Review and update procedures regularly
expected_outcomes: Operating procedures are documented and available
Procedures are up to date and reflect current operations
Personnel follow documented procedures
audit_intent: Verify that operating procedures for information processing facilities are documented and available.

title: Screening
objective: Ensure personnel are suitable for their roles before employment.
description: Background verification checks on all candidates for employment shall be carried out in accordance with relevant laws, regulations, and ethics, and proportional to the business requirements, the classification of the information to be accessed, and the perceived risks.
implementation_guidance: Conduct background checks before extending employment offers
Tailor screening depth to role sensitivity and information access level
Include identity verification, criminal record, and credential checks
Document screening policies and obtain candidate consent
expected_outcomes: Background checks are conducted before hiring
Screening depth matches role sensitivity
Screening policies are documented and consistently applied
Results are documented and reviewed
audit_intent: Verify that background checks are conducted before employment.

title: Terms and Conditions of Employment
objective: Ensure personnel understand their information security responsibilities.
description: The employment agreement shall state the employee's and the organization's responsibilities for information security.
implementation_guidance: Include information security responsibilities in employment contracts
Include confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements in terms
Communicate security expectations during onboarding
Document consequences of non-compliance with security policies
expected_outcomes: Employment agreements include information security responsibilities
Employees acknowledge their security obligations
Confidentiality agreements are signed where required
Consequences of non-compliance are documented
audit_intent: Verify that employment agreements include information security responsibilities.

title: Information Security Awareness, Education and Training
objective: Ensure personnel are aware of and competent in information security.
description: Personnel of the organization and relevant external parties shall receive appropriate information security awareness, education, and training, and regular updates on organizational policies and procedures relevant to their role.
implementation_guidance: Develop an information security awareness program
Conduct awareness training for all employees upon hiring and annually
Provide role-specific security training for privileged positions
Assess effectiveness of awareness and training programs
expected_outcomes: All employees complete security awareness training
Role-specific training is provided for privileged roles
Awareness program effectiveness is evaluated
Training records are maintained
audit_intent: Verify that personnel receive information security awareness, education, and training.

title: Disciplinary Process
objective: Enforce consistent disciplinary action for security policy violations.
description: A disciplinary process shall be defined and communicated to take action against personnel who have committed an information security breach.
implementation_guidance: Establish a formal disciplinary process for security violations
Communicate disciplinary consequences in policies and training
Apply sanctions consistently and proportionally
Document all disciplinary actions related to security
expected_outcomes: Disciplinary process for security violations exists
Personnel are aware of consequences of non-compliance
Disciplinary actions are documented and consistent
audit_intent: Verify that a disciplinary process exists for addressing security breaches.

title: Responsibilities After Termination or Change of Employment
objective: Protect organizational interests when employment ends or changes.
description: Information security responsibilities and duties that remain valid after termination or change of employment shall be defined, communicated to the employee or contractor, and enforced.
implementation_guidance: Define post-termination security obligations (confidentiality, non-disclosure)
Communicate ongoing obligations at the time of termination
Ensure return of all organizational assets
Revoke all access rights upon termination
expected_outcomes: Post-termination obligations are defined and communicated
Assets are returned upon termination
Access rights are revoked promptly
audit_intent: Verify that post-termination security responsibilities are defined, communicated, and enforced.

title: Confidentiality or Non-Disclosure Agreements
objective: Protect confidential information through legally enforceable agreements.
description: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements reflecting the organization's needs for the protection of information shall be identified, documented, regularly reviewed, and signed by employees and relevant external parties.
implementation_guidance: Use NDAs for employees with access to sensitive information
Include NDAs in supplier and third-party agreements
Review NDA terms regularly
Maintain a record of all signed NDAs
expected_outcomes: NDAs are signed by employees and relevant external parties
NDA terms are reviewed and updated regularly
NDA records are maintained
audit_intent: Verify that NDAs are used to protect confidential information.

title: Remote Working
objective: Maintain information security when personnel work remotely.
description: Security measures shall be implemented to protect information accessed, processed, or stored at remote work locations.
implementation_guidance: Define remote working policy and security requirements
Provide secure remote access (VPN, MFA)
Ensure endpoint protection on remote devices
Train remote workers on security best practices
expected_outcomes: Remote working policy is documented
Secure remote access is provided
Remote devices have appropriate security controls
Remote workers are trained on security requirements
audit_intent: Verify that security measures are implemented for remote working.

title: Information Security Event Reporting
objective: Enable prompt reporting of information security events.
description: The organization shall provide a mechanism for personnel to report observed or suspected information security events through appropriate channels in a timely manner.
implementation_guidance: Establish a clear reporting channel for security events
Provide multiple reporting mechanisms (email, phone, portal)
Encourage a no-blame reporting culture
Acknowledge receipt of reports and provide status updates
expected_outcomes: Reporting mechanism is accessible to all personnel
Security events are reported in a timely manner
Reporters receive acknowledgement and feedback
audit_intent: Verify that personnel have a mechanism to report information security events.

title: Physical Security Perimeters
objective: Define and maintain physical security boundaries.
description: Security perimeters shall be defined and used to protect areas that contain information and other associated assets.
implementation_guidance: Define physical security perimeters for sensitive areas
Use physical barriers (walls, locked doors, fencing) to enforce perimeters
Implement intrusion detection at perimeters
Review perimeter effectiveness regularly
expected_outcomes: Physical perimeters are defined for sensitive areas
Physical barriers prevent unauthorized access
Perimeter security is monitored and maintained
audit_intent: Verify that physical security perimeters are defined and maintained.

title: Physical Entry
objective: Control physical access to secure areas.
description: Secure areas shall be protected by appropriate entry controls to ensure that only authorized personnel are allowed access.
implementation_guidance: Implement access control mechanisms at entry points (badges, biometrics, PIN)
Maintain visitor logs and escrow procedures
Review access rights to secure areas regularly
Alert on unauthorized access attempts
expected_outcomes: Entry to secure areas requires authentication
Visitors are logged and escorted
Access rights to secure areas are reviewed regularly
audit_intent: Verify that physical entry controls are in place for secure areas.

title: Securing Offices, Rooms, and Facilities
objective: Secure physical spaces containing information assets.
description: Physical security for offices, rooms, and facilities shall be designed and implemented.
implementation_guidance: Apply lock and key control to offices and server rooms
Implement environmental controls (fire suppression, climate control)
Use secure cabinets for sensitive paper documents
Implement clear desk and clear screen policies
expected_outcomes: Offices and facilities are physically secure
Environmental controls protect sensitive equipment
Sensitive documents are stored securely
Clear desk and clear screen policies are followed
audit_intent: Verify that offices, rooms, and facilities are physically secured.

title: Physical Security Monitoring
objective: Detect and deter physical security breaches.
description: Premises shall be continuously monitored for unauthorized physical access.
implementation_guidance: Install CCTV or other monitoring systems at key entry points
Implement alarm systems for doors and windows
Maintain monitoring and alarm logs
Respond promptly to alarms and alerts
expected_outcomes: Monitoring systems are in place for critical areas
Alarms are monitored and responded to
Monitoring logs are retained and reviewed
audit_intent: Verify that physical security is monitored to detect breaches.

title: Protection Against Physical and Environmental Threats
objective: Protect information assets from physical and environmental threats.
description: Protection against physical and environmental threats, such as natural disasters, fire, flooding, earthquakes, vandalism, and terrorism, shall be designed and implemented.
implementation_guidance: Conduct physical risk assessments for facilities
Install fire suppression and detection systems
Implement environmental monitoring (temperature, humidity, water)
Develop contingency plans for natural disasters
expected_outcomes: Physical threats are assessed and mitigated
Fire and environmental detection systems are installed
Business continuity plans address physical threats
audit_intent: Verify that facilities are protected against physical and environmental threats.

title: Working in Secure Areas
objective: Maintain security in secure areas through procedural controls.
description: Procedures for working in secure areas shall be designed and implemented.
implementation_guidance: Restrict access to secure areas to authorized personnel only
Implement sign-in/sign-out procedures for secure areas
Escort visitors in secure areas at all times
Prohibit cameras and recording devices in secure areas
expected_outcomes: Access to secure areas is restricted and logged
Visitors are escorted in secure areas
Procedures for working in secure areas are followed
audit_intent: Verify that procedures for working in secure areas are documented and followed.

title: Clear Desk and Clear Screen
objective: Reduce risk of unauthorized access to information on desks and screens.
description: Clear desk and clear screen rules shall be defined and implemented.
implementation_guidance: Require all papers and media to be stored securely when not in use
